(Japanese: マコ Mako) is a Pokémon Trainer and a minor character who appeared in White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram.

==In the movies==
She battled in a tournament in Eindoak Town with her . Eventually, Ash's Pikachu managed to defeat Serperior, causing her to be eliminated from the tournament.
